name: John Beers
role: Medora man who left with Wright as the Cantonment was attached
bio: John Beers escorted George Wilder and his wife of Iowa to the Black Hills in summer 1885. In October 1885 he and Wright left Medora, Beers for a railroad job in Butte, after turning the Cantonment over to the sheriff to satisfy attachments.

moments.label: Left with the Wilders for the Black Hills
Left for Butte; Cantonment turned over to sheriff

mentions: J. F. B[e?]ers started yesterday morning with Mr. and Mrs. Wilder, of Iowa, for the Black Hills.
